checked_sources_new.title: AutoResearchEval public implementation and release boundary
AI CFD Scientist official verifier-ablation implementation
R&D-Agent: An LLM-Agent Framework Towards Autonomous Data Science
checked_sources_new.type: primary modular autonomous data-science agent ablation

candidate_mechanisms_new.mechanism: Two-fidelity development gate: prototype and debug a proposed research implementation on a small representative subset until it is runnable and logically sound, then admit only validated implementations to expensive full-scale execution.
candidate_mechanisms_new.evidence: R&D-Agent v2 separates research from development and directly ablates its sample-based coding workflow under a 12-hour MLE-Bench budget. A representative full-system run reaches 34.7% Any Medal, while replacing the efficient iterative/sample-based debug workflow with full-dataset debugging reaches 24.0% and remains persistently degraded. The paper describes the full workflow as sampling a representative subset, iterating implementation/testing/refinement there, and only then proceeding to full-scale evaluation.
candidate_mechanisms_new.interpretation: For costly autonomous experiments, implementation debugging should use a cheaper fidelity before consuming the full experiment budget. This is an execution-efficiency gate, not evidence that the cheap subset is scientifically sufficient; final claims still require full-fidelity evaluation.
candidate_mechanisms_new.scope: Direct system ablation in data-science/MLE tasks under a fixed time budget. Development-phase curves use one representative ablation/main run rather than a multi-seed matched estimate, so effect size uncertainty is higher than the paper's three-seed headline results.

candidate_mechanisms_new.mechanism: Community-impact proposal prior: train a separate field/time-controlled preference model on large-scale community signals and use it only to rank or prefilter research proposals before expensive execution, never as a validity/evidence gate.
candidate_mechanisms_new.evidence: AI Can Learn Scientific Taste trains Scientific Judge on 720,341 field- and time-matched citation-preference pairs. Qwen3-30B improves from 71.6% to 87.0% temporal-OOD pairwise accuracy on 2025 papers; on ICLR review-score pairs it improves by 11.8 points to 88.5%, and on Altmetric pairs by 8.2 points to 86.3%. A policy trained with this judge as reward achieves 81.5% in-domain and 83.0% temporal-holdout win rate against its base policy versus 73.0%/70.5% when trained with the baseline reward model.
candidate_mechanisms_new.interpretation: Community signals can supply a transferable proposal-selection prior that is distinct from execution competence. The safe use is triage/diversification of what to test, followed by independent feasibility, experiment, provenance and validity gates.
candidate_mechanisms_new.scope: The learned construct is community-defined potential impact, primarily from citations. Generated ideas were judged by strong LLMs on potential impact and were not experimentally validated; the authors explicitly note citation bias and lack of experimental ideation validation. Do not call this scientific validity, truth, or realized impact.

evidence_refinements: AutoResearchEval release boundary is now source-qualified: agent-as-a-judge/.gitignore explicitly excludes generate/corpus, classify/corpus, classify/results, and classify/_ws_arft as runtime working data. The public release exposes task/rollout material and classification code, but the generated per-trajectory classification.json/results corpus needed to measure F.4 actionability is not committed in the inspected GitHub release. Therefore candidate 027's 660/800 F.4 prevalence cannot be converted into 'repairable after self-awareness' rates from released labels alone; a new artifact-aware re-judging/classification pass is required.

Candidate 030 reproducibility boundary tightened: AI CFD Scientist releases the exact 20-case planted-failure driver and perturbation definitions, but its repository .gitignore excludes runs/ and data/. The expected runs/nips_2026/vlm_ablation output path is absent publicly. Thus the published 14/16 detection result has released reconstruction code but not an independently inspectable per-case decision/ground-truth archive in the current public repository.

Search topology versus memory is more cleanly separated by R&D-Agent v2. On its 40-competition research ablation, Full Any Medal is 35.1±0.4%; replacing adaptive exploration path with sequential chain gives 25.3%, while degrading collaborative memory gives 32.0%. This supports treating search topology as a mechanism distinct from memory enrichment rather than attributing branching gains to stored context alone.

Structured reasoning quality is not reducible to iteration count in the same ablation: removing the multi-step reasoning pipeline raises average loops from 45.9 to 55.3 while Improve Rate drops from 41.1% to 23.0% and Any Medal to 26.7%. More autonomous iterations can be actively low-value if the hypothesis/reasoning compiler is weak.
negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: Released code that reconstructs an assay is weaker reproducibility evidence than released raw result archives. Both AutoResearchEval generated ARFT classifications and AI-CFD run-level ablation outputs are excluded from the inspected public GitHub trees by explicit runtime/run ignore policies.

R&D-Agent research ablation columns other than Full System are single representative runs due compute constraints; development-phase ablations also use representative trajectories. Do not treat the exact percentage gaps as precise multi-seed causal estimates.

R&D-Agent is an MLE/data-science environment. Two-fidelity debugging supports resource-efficient implementation, not scientific validity of subset results or direct transfer to wet-lab/physical experiments.

Scientific Judge learns community preference signals. Citation, peer-review score and attention transfer do not establish truth or experimental validity, and Scientific Thinker ideation was evaluated mainly by LLM judges without executing the ideas.
frontier_additions: Reconstruct a small source-qualified sample of AutoResearchEval F.4 cases from released trajectories and artifacts, if sufficient evidence packages are public, and measure whether a corrective tool action occurred after the self-identified flaw and whether the same flaw remained in the final artifact.
Search a second autonomous-research system for a matched cheap-fidelity versus full-fidelity implementation/debugging ablation to test candidate 031 outside MLE-Bench.

Inspect the public R&D-Agent implementation/results for raw ablation seeds or per-competition trajectories; quantify whether the coding-workflow gain comes from more attempted hypotheses, fewer runtime failures, or both.
Seek scientist-agent training with a matched environment/artifact-grounded progress reward versus free-form LLM-judge reward, directly testing candidate 028 in a research setting.
Seek human or prospective experimental validation of community-trained scientific-impact ranking before allowing candidate 032 to influence anything beyond proposal triage.

Find a physical/lab autonomous-science system that releases both planted/natural failure-class raw outputs and detector decisions, providing an independent reproducibility test of observability-matched validation.
